acy-bing-1.webp.zh: 航站楼临街面：银灰色幕墙配大面积落地玻璃，右侧墙上写着「ATLANTIC CITY INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT」。
acy-bing-1.webp.en: The landside face of the terminal — silver panelling and broad glazing, with 'ATLANTIC CITY INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT' lettered on the right.

acy-bing-2.webp.zh: 机场入口的「A」字雕塑标志：蓝色大字母穿过一架小飞机的剪影，立在航站楼前的草坪上。
acy-bing-2.webp.en: The 'A' monument at the airport entrance: a blue letter slicing through a small aircraft silhouette on the lawn before the terminal.

acy-bing-3.webp.zh: 航拍大西洋城国际机场：航站楼与登机指廊居中，四周是成片停车场与滑行道，远处大西洋城的天际线浮在地平线上。
acy-bing-3.webp.en: Aerial view of Atlantic City International: terminal and concourse in the middle, car parks and taxiways all around, the city skyline floating on the horizon.
